Privacy.title: privacy notice
Privacy.draft: Provisional version, to be reviewed by the faculty before public launch.
Privacy.p1: mostra stores your email, your name and the profile details you choose to fill in, the works you publish and the messages you send.
Privacy.p2: We use this data only to run the platform: showing works with the visibility you choose, connecting students with opportunities and letting people contact each other under the platform's rules.
Privacy.p3: We use no tracking cookies. You will be able to export or delete your account at any time.
